top_signals.title: Circle CEO: Clarity Act is Not Dead
top_signals.summary: Circle CEO and Co-Founder Jeremy Allaire joins Bloomberg Open Interest to lay out his massive vision for digital dollars, saying stablecoins could address a roughly $60 trillion cash market. He explains why Circle doesn’t need the CLARITY Act to scale, calls blockchain finance an “irreversible megatrend,” and details the launch of Arc with hundreds of companies already participating. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Strong Retail Sales Hide Consumer Divide: Analyst Kodali
top_signals.summary: Forrester analyst Sucharita Kodali says strong retail sales are hiding a major divide in the US consumer. Higher-income shoppers are still spending, while rising gas costs squeeze lower-income households. She explains why Walmart, Costco and Amazon could gain even more ground this holiday season as middle-tier retailers struggle. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Senate is still a tossup, but Democrats now have slight edge, prediction market traders think
top_signals.summary: Traders on both Kalshi and Polymarket see Democrats with one of their best chances to flip the U.S. Senate since the contracts on the election opened.
